import os
import math
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

output_dir = r"C:\Users\renu5\Downloads\stickman_master_asset"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

width, height = 1920, 1080

def draw_stickman(draw, frame_idx):
    # Base coordinates for the stickman
    head_x, head_y = 600, 500
    head_radius = 80
    body_start_y = head_y + head_radius
    body_end_y = body_start_y + 250
    
    # Draw head
    draw.ellipse(
        [(head_x - head_radius, head_y - head_radius),
         (head_x + head_radius, head_y + head_radius)],
        outline="black", width=12, fill="white"
    )
    
    # Confused face
    # Eyes - slightly uneven
    draw.ellipse([(head_x - 30, head_y - 25), (head_x - 15, head_y - 10)], fill="black")
    draw.ellipse([(head_x + 15, head_y - 20), (head_x + 30, head_y - 5)], fill="black")
    
    # Confused eyebrows (one up, one down)
    draw.line([(head_x - 40, head_y - 45), (head_x - 10, head_y - 35)], fill="black", width=6)
    draw.line([(head_x + 10, head_y - 30), (head_x + 40, head_y - 40)], fill="black", width=6)
    
    # Squiggly mouth
    draw.line([(head_x - 20, head_y + 30), (head_x - 10, head_y + 20), 
               (head_x, head_y + 35), (head_x + 10, head_y + 20),
               (head_x + 20, head_y + 30)], fill="black", width=5)
    
    # Question marks floating
    if frame_idx % 20 < 10:
        # Question mark 1
        draw.arc([head_x - 100, head_y - 150, head_x - 60, head_y - 110], 180, 0, fill="black", width=6)
        draw.line([head_x - 60, head_y - 130, head_x - 60, head_y - 110], fill="black", width=6)
        draw.line([head_x - 60, head_y - 110, head_x - 80, head_y - 100], fill="black", width=6)
        draw.line([head_x - 80, head_y - 100, head_x - 80, head_y - 80], fill="black", width=6)
        draw.ellipse([head_x - 85, head_y - 70, head_x - 75, head_y - 60], fill="black")
        
        # Question mark 2
        draw.arc([head_x + 40, head_y - 180, head_x + 80, head_y - 140], 180, 0, fill="black", width=6)
        draw.line([head_x + 80, head_y - 160, head_x + 80, head_y - 140], fill="black", width=6)
        draw.line([head_x + 80, head_y - 140, head_x + 60, head_y - 130], fill="black", width=6)
        draw.line([head_x + 60, head_y - 130, head_x + 60, head_y - 110], fill="black", width=6)
        draw.ellipse([head_x + 55, head_y - 100, head_x + 65, head_y - 90], fill="black")

    # Draw body
    draw.line([(head_x, body_start_y), (head_x, body_end_y)], fill="black", width=12)
    
    # Draw legs
    draw.line([(head_x, body_end_y), (head_x - 80, body_end_y + 200)], fill="black", width=12)
    draw.line([(head_x, body_end_y), (head_x + 80, body_end_y + 200)], fill="black", width=12)
    
    # Draw right arm (pointing at board, static)
    draw.line([(head_x, body_start_y + 50), (head_x + 200, body_start_y + 20)], fill="black", width=12)
    
    # Draw left arm (scratching head, animated)
    shoulder_x, shoulder_y = head_x, body_start_y + 50
    
    # Animate scratching
    t = frame_idx - 91
    
    # Scratching motion is a sine wave
    scratch_offset_x = math.sin(t * 0.6) * 15
    scratch_offset_y = math.cos(t * 0.6) * 15
    
    # Hand on head
    hand_x = head_x - head_radius + 20 + scratch_offset_x
    hand_y = head_y - head_radius + 20 + scratch_offset_y
    
    # Elbow
    elbow_x = shoulder_x - 130
    elbow_y = shoulder_y - 30 + scratch_offset_y
    
    draw.line([(shoulder_x, shoulder_y), (elbow_x, elbow_y)], fill="black", width=12)
    draw.line([(elbow_x, elbow_y), (hand_x, hand_y)], fill="black", width=12)

def draw_blackboard(draw):
    # Blackboard frame
    draw.rectangle([800, 150, 1800, 850], fill="#5C4033", outline="black", width=10)
    # Blackboard surface
    draw.rectangle([820, 170, 1780, 830], fill="#2E4A35")
    
    # Confusing math on the blackboard
    # 1 + 1 = 3
    draw.line([950, 250, 950, 350], fill="white", width=6)
    
    draw.line([1020, 300, 1080, 300], fill="white", width=6)
    draw.line([1050, 270, 1050, 330], fill="white", width=6)
    
    draw.line([1150, 250, 1150, 350], fill="white", width=6)
    
    draw.line([1220, 280, 1280, 280], fill="white", width=6)
    draw.line([1220, 320, 1280, 320], fill="white", width=6)
    
    # Draw 3
    draw.arc([1330, 250, 1390, 300], 270, 90, fill="white", width=6)
    draw.arc([1330, 300, 1390, 350], 270, 90, fill="white", width=6)
    
    # Complex integral symbol
    draw.arc([900, 500, 950, 600], 90, 270, fill="white", width=6)
    draw.line([925, 500, 925, 750], fill="white", width=6)
    draw.arc([900, 650, 950, 750], 270, 90, fill="white", width=6)
    
    # random math squiggles
    for i in range(15):
        draw.line([1000 + i*30, 600 + math.sin(i)*60, 1030 + i*30, 600 + math.sin(i+1)*60], fill="white", width=6)

for i in range(91, 181):
    img = Image.new('RGB', (width, height), color='#00FF00')
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    
    draw_blackboard(draw)
    draw_stickman(draw, i)
    
    filename = f"frame_{i:03d}.png"
    filepath = os.path.join(output_dir, filename)
    img.save(filepath)
    print(f"Saved {filepath}")
